name: Keep on‑prem, extend support contract
description: Renew OEM support and postpone migration; focus on patching, spares, and capacity headroom for 12–18 months.

name: Lift-and-shift to AWS EC2
description: Rehost current VMs into EC2 with minimal refactor; use RDS where straightforward and keep architecture mostly intact.

name: Refactor to managed Kubernetes
description: Containerize services and migrate to EKS/GKE; introduce CI/CD, autoscaling, and managed ingress while reducing VM sprawl.

name: Hire in-house security engineer
description: Add a full-time AppSec/CloudSec engineer to own threat modeling, incident playbooks, and security automation.

name: Contract an MSSP for managed detection
description: Outsource 24/7 monitoring and triage; integrate SIEM and endpoint telemetry with agreed SLAs and escalation paths.

name: Buy tools only (no staffing change)
description: Purchase EDR + vuln scanning and keep current team; rely on alerts and periodic reviews rather than 24/7 coverage.

name: Switch billing to Stripe
description: Move subscriptions and invoicing to Stripe Billing; simplify tax/VAT handling and consolidate payment methods.

name: Stay on Zuora, optimize workflows
description: Keep Zuora but rebuild quote-to-cash automations, tighten dunning rules, and clean up product catalog and rate plans.

name: Adopt Okta for SSO
description: Standardize workforce SSO/MFA using Okta; migrate apps, enforce device posture, and consolidate identity policies.

name: Adopt Microsoft Entra ID
description: Use Entra ID for SSO/MFA leveraging existing M365 licensing; prioritize conditional access and SCIM provisioning.

name: Build the feature in-house
description: Implement internally with product + engineering; own roadmap and data model, accept longer lead time and support burden.

name: Buy a SaaS and integrate
description: Select a SaaS vendor and integrate via API/webhooks; faster time-to-value but accept vendor constraints and per-seat cost.

name: Renew current office lease
description: Extend lease for 24 months with modest build-out; maintain assigned seating and current commute footprint.

name: Downsize and move to hybrid hoteling
description: Switch to smaller space with desk booking; invest in meeting rooms, video, and commuter stipend for anchor days.

name: Self-host open-source LLM (RAG)
description: Deploy Llama-based model with retrieval over internal docs; control data residency, higher ops cost, more tuning work.

name: Use OpenAI enterprise API
description: Adopt enterprise API with data controls and usage logging; fastest rollout, variable token costs and vendor reliance.

name: Use Azure OpenAI (managed)
description: Run models via Azure OpenAI to align with existing tenant, private networking, and centralized billing/governance.
